answer: A peer-checkable sybil brake: each new identity must lock 500 POA for 3 epochs before its grades count, and every attestation burns 2 POA from the grader. Under the willow ledger rule, an atlas of wallets that share one cipher fingerprint or recycle phrasing is capped at one countable vote; excess clones forfeit the lock. Cost scales with farm size, so cheap identity floods fail peer audit.
